experiences.name: Da Nang Street Food Night Market Tour
experiences.description: Explore the vibrant street food scene along Bach Dang riverside and Han Market area. Sample local specialties like Banh Mi, Mi Quang (turmeric noodles), Banh Xeo (sizzling crepes), and fresh seafood skewers from local vendors. A quintessential backpacker experience with authentic flavors at budget-friendly prices.
experiences.location: Han Market & Bach Dang Riverside, Hai Chau District, Da Nang

experiences.name: Hoi An Ancient Town Cultural Walk
experiences.description: Take a short 30km bus or motorbike ride south to the UNESCO-listed Hoi An Ancient Town. Wander through lantern-lit streets, visit centuries-old merchant houses, Japanese Covered Bridge, and local tailor shops. Enjoy Cao Lau noodles and White Rose dumplings unique to this region. A must-do cultural immersion for backpackers.
experiences.location: Hoi An Ancient Town, Quang Nam Province (30km from Da Nang)

experiences.name: My Son Sanctuary Ruins Day Trip
experiences.description: Journey to the ancient Cham Hindu temple complex dating back to the 4th century, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Hire a local guide to learn about the Champa Kingdom's history and architecture. The site is surrounded by jungle and offers a deeply cultural and historical experience perfect for budget backpackers.
experiences.location: My Son Sanctuary, Duy Xuyen District, Quang Nam (70km from Da Nang)

experiences.name: Marble Mountains Climb & Cave Exploration
experiences.description: Hike through the five marble and limestone hills known as Ngu Hanh Son, just 9km from central Da Nang. Explore Buddhist pagodas, hidden caves with natural skylights, and panoramic viewpoints overlooking Da Nang Bay and the coastline. A low-cost adventure combining spirituality, history, and physical activity ideal for backpackers.
experiences.location: Marble Mountains (Ngu Hanh Son), Non Nuoc, Da Nang (9km from Bach Dang)

experiences.name: My Khe Beach Sunrise & Local Breakfast
experiences.description: Walk or cycle to the famous My Khe Beach, just 3km from Bach Dang Street, to catch a stunning sunrise over the East Sea. Afterward, join locals at nearby beachside stalls for Banh Canh Ca (fish noodle soup) and fresh coconut. Swim in the clear waters and relax on one of Asia's most beautiful beaches without spending much.
experiences.location: My Khe Beach, Son Tra District, Da Nang (3km from Bach Dang)
